description.value: Passage View Motel is a 30-room oceanfront property in Campbell River, BC, positioned directly on the ocean side of the Island Highway with unobstructed views of Discovery Passage, Quadra Island, and the Coastal Mountains from every room. Guests have private access to the rocky shoreline below, where seals, Orcas, dolphins, and a variety of seabirds are regularly spotted. The motel offers pet-friendly rooms and serves as a convenient base for salmon fishing, Strathcona Provincial Park hiking, and ferry day trips to Quadra and Cortes Islands.

address.value: 517 Island Hwy, Campbell River, BC V9W 2B9

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and active (housekeeping rules updated October 2023), confirming the motel is operating. The site mentions a complimentary light take-away breakfast available seasonally, pet-friendly rooms, and private beach access, but makes no mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, laundry, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities. Address and phone from the website corroborate the OSM address; OSM had no phone listed so that field is sourced from the website.
